root_cause: The global .card rule used grid-column: span 4, and the legal section menu also had class card. Inside .legal-layout that made the side menu span implicit grid columns, pushing and visually colliding with the terms document.
fixes: Forced .legal-layout to a controlled two-column grid on desktop.
Forced .legal-layout > .toc into column 1 and .legal-layout > .legal-doc into column 2.
Neutralized inherited .card grid-column behavior inside legal layouts.
Collapsed legal layout to one clean column under 1120px.
Removed max-height/sticky behavior on narrow screens so menu cannot cover content.
